title: GEE PLAYS Gaming Hub
description: A gaming hub that allows users to explore, play, and share their favorite games. It features a user-friendly interface, game recommendations, and social sharing capabilities.

details.problem: The website helps gamers find and play games easily, providing a platform for game discovery and social interaction.
details.solution: Directly access a curated list of games, read reviews, and share experiences with other gamers.
details.learned: Hosting and deploying a web application, and implementing responsive design for various devices. Also handking API and proxy to bypass browser to API server communicatons
details.challenges: Managing game data and ensuring the website remains responsive across different screen sizes. solving this by using media queries and testing on multiple devices. Also  a redirect pretending to be a CORS error solved by turning off Vercel Authentication for the project
